chromatic_orb.name: Chromatic Orb
chromatic_orb.description: Hurl a sphere of volatile elemental energy. Deals {dice} damage to a single target.

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: Conjure glowing darts of magical force that unerringly strike your foe. Unavoidably deals {dice} force damage.

cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure_wounds.description: Channel restorative magic through a healing touch. Restores {dice} HP to the target.

guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding_bolt.description: A brilliant flash of divine light streaks toward your enemy. Deals {dice} radiant damage and grants Advantage on the next attack made against them.

inflict_wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflict_wounds.description: Unleash a surge of dark, necrotic energy through a devastating touch. Deals {dice} necrotic damage to a single creature.

scorching_ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching_ray.description: Conjure searing rays of intense flame and hurl them at your foes. Make {attack_count_overide} ranged spell attacks, each dealing {dice} fire damage.

spiritual_weapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritual_weapon.description: Manifest a spectral weapon to strike down your enemies. Deals an initial {dice} force damage, and continues to assail the target for {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

hold_person.name: Hold Person
hold_person.description: Bind a humanoid foe with paralyzing, invisible chains. The target must succeed on a saving throw or become {effect} for {duration} turns.

moonbeam.name: Moonbeam
moonbeam.description: Call down a searing beam of pale, silvery moonlight. Deals {dice} radiant damage initially, and burns the target for an additional {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: A bright streak flashes from your finger, blossoming into a devastating explosion of flame. Deals {dice} fire damage to all targets in the blast radius. A successful save halves the damage.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.description: Unleash a brilliant stroke of lightning that tears through enemy ranks. Deals {dice} lightning damage to all targets caught in its path. A successful save halves the damage.

haste.name: Haste
haste.description: Energize an ally with preternatural speed. Grants the {effect} status for {duration} turns, drastically increasing their speed, evasiveness, and granting an additional action each turn.

blight.name: Blight
blight.description: Flood a creature with corrupting necrotic energy, rapidly draining their moisture and vitality. Deals {dice} necrotic damage. A successful save halves the damage.

wall_of_fire.name: Wall of Fire
wall_of_fire.description: Conjure a roaring wall of searing flames. Erupts for an initial {dice} fire damage, and violently burns targets trapped within the inferno for an additional {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

ice_storm.name: Ice Storm
ice_storm.description: Call down a punishing storm of magical hail and freezing rain. Crushes targets for {dice} cold and bludgeoning damage initially. Those who fail their save suffer {effect} and take {dot_dice} freezing damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

cone_of_cold.name: Cone of Cold
cone_of_cold.description: Unleash a devastating blast of freezing air from your outstretched hands. Deals {dice} cold damage to all enemies in the blast area. Targets that fail their save suffer a {power} penalty ({effect}). A successful save halves the damage.

immolation.name: Immolation
immolation.description: Engulf a target in roaring, magical flames. Incinerates the foe for an initial {dice} fire damage, and continues to violently burn them for an additional {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
maelstrom.description: Conjure a churning, tempestuous whirlpool that engulfs the battlefield. Deals an initial {dice} bludgeoning damage to ALL enemies. Those caught within are battered for an additional {dot_dice} damage each turn and suffer {effect}. Lasts for {duration} turns.

mass_cure_wounds.name: Mass Cure Wounds
mass_cure_wounds.description: Radiate a brilliant wave of restorative energy that washes over your allies. Restores {dice} HP to all targets within the healing radius.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.description: Unleash a terrifying bolt of lightning that violently arcs between your enemies. Deals {dice} lightning damage to ALL targets on the battlefield. A successful save halves the damage.

sunbeam.name: Sunbeam
sunbeam.description: Unleash a beam of blinding, brilliant light. Deals an initial {dice} radiant damage to targets caught in the blast. Those who fail their save are {effect} and suffer an additional {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
disintegrate.description: Fire a deadly, thin green ray of pure destructive force. Deals a devastating {dice} force damage. Targets reduced to 0 hit points by this spell are instantly turned to ash.

finger_of_death.name: Finger of Death
finger_of_death.description: Channel ultimate necrotic power, sending fatal negative energy coursing through a single creature's veins. Deals {dice} necrotic damage. A successful save halves the damage.

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.description: Stimulate a target's natural healing to superhuman levels. Instantly restores {dice} HP, and continues to rapidly heal the target for {hot_dice} HP at the start of each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

fire_storm.name: Fire Storm
fire_storm.description: Summon a raging tempest of roaring flames that blankets the entire battlefield. Deals an initial {dice} fire damage to ALL enemies. Foes caught in the inferno continue to burn for {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

prismatic_spray.name: Prismatic Spray
prismatic_spray.description: Unleash a dazzling, chaotic array of multicolored light. Blasts targets in the area for {dice} magical damage and inflicts a {effect} status ailment depending on the color that strikes them. Status effects last for {duration} turns.

sunburst.name: Sunburst
sunburst.description: Unleash a brilliant flash of searing sunlight across the entire battlefield. Deals {dice} radiant damage to ALL enemies. Those who fail their save are rendered {effect}. A successful save halves the damage.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.description: Trigger a massive seismic disturbance that violently tears the battlefield apart. Deals {dice} bludgeoning damage to ALL enemies and leaves those who fail their save {effect}.

illusory_dragon.name: Illusory Dragon
illusory_dragon.description: Manifest a terrifying, semi-real illusion of a towering dragon. Its breath deals an initial {dice} damage to targets in the area, leaving them {effect}. The phantom beast continues to breathe for {dot_dice} damage each turn. Lasts for {duration} turns.

meteor_swarm.name: Meteor Swarm
meteor_swarm.description: Tear open the heavens and call down a cataclysmic shower of blazing meteors. Deals a devastating {dice} damage to ALL enemies on the battlefield. A successful save halves the damage.

power_word_kill.name: Power Word Kill
power_word_kill.description: Utter a word of ultimate, lethal power. If the target has {hp_threshold} HP or less, they are instantly slain (taking {threshold_damage} damage). Otherwise, the sheer force of the word deals {else_damage} damage.

mass_heal.name: Mass Heal
mass_heal.description: Unleash a boundless torrent of divine restorative magic. Restores a massive {dice} HP to all allies in the area and instantly applies {effect}.

conjure_animals.name: Conjure Animals
conjure_animals.description: Call upon fey beasts of the wild to aid you in battle. Summons {summon_count} Owlbear(s) to fight alongside your party.

conjure_woodland_beings.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
conjure_woodland_beings.description: Call upon the spirits of the forest to aid you in battle. Summons {summon_count} Dryad(s) to fight alongside your party.

draconic_spirit.name: Draconic Spirit
draconic_spirit.description: Manifest the ancient power of dragons. Summons {summon_count} Wyrmling(s) to burn your enemies.

summon_dragon.name: Summon Dragon
summon_dragon.description: Manifest the ancient power of dragons. Summons a Young Dragon to incinerate your enemies.
